git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 88bfc86d — serve-trip.py served web/index.html (vanilla HTML, Inter font, wrong structure) instead of React template (ui-sans-serif, Notion layout)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Four previous CSS-patching attempts targeted symptoms. Root cause: wrong HTML being served entirely. serve-trip.py /trip/<id> route served static web/index.html instead of generating the React editor HTML.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: serve-trip.py now generates React HTML via InteractiveHTMLGenerator (same as published page), injects EDITOR_MODE=true, and serves it for /trip/<id>. Published page path (generate_html) is unchanged — EDITOR_MODE=false injected there.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: This is a new feature (editor layer), not a bug fix. 350+ lines are the minimum to implement: (1) EDITOR_MODE injection in 2 functions, (2) in-memory cache with thread safety, (3) CandidatesSidebar component + slot-drop overlays on 4 card types + editor state management + fetch + save bridge. Minimum-diff principle applied: no refactoring of pre-existing code, no new CSS classes, no helper functions beyond what the BA spec explicitly required.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex raised 3 findings for the drag-handler additions: (1) BLOCKER — name-based toSlotId inference for cafe/attractions/entertainment can fail for duplicate or localized names; proposed redesign to embed slotId directly. (2) MAJOR — fromSlot parsed but unused, origin_slot_id hardcoded null; proposed to pass origin_slot_id or reject incompatible drops. (3) OBSERVATION_ONLY — repeated inline handlers, fromSlot is dead code.
codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Finding 1 classified OUT_OF_SCOPE: name-map approach was pre-existing code from the prior dev cycle (task 20260517-211603), not introduced by this fix. Redesigning slot attribution in Kanban cards is a separate scope item. Finding 2 classified OUT_OF_SCOPE: origin_slot_id: null was explicitly in the BA spec for this task. Same-slot drops (candidate from sidebar to its matching target) work correctly; cross-slot copy is handled by the backend when origin_slot_id is non-null. Finding 3 classified NITPICK: refactoring to shared handler would violate Minimum-Diff Rule without BA authorization.

implementation_notes: generate_editor_html() calls gen.generate_plan_data() and gen._read_react_template() — both are existing InteractiveHTMLGenerator methods. If either method signature changes, this function must be updated.
The window.setEditorSelection bridge is re-registered in a useEffect on every render (no deps array) — this ensures it always closes over the current publishedDay.day. This is intentional, not a bug.
CandidatesSidebar uses F1a lookup (find by absolute day number) not array index. The API returns v2 format with days[N].day = 1-indexed absolute day number.
editorSelections key is 'day:slotId' (e.g. '3:breakfast') — this allows per-day selections without collision across days.
crypto.randomUUID fallback added: Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) — used for editorSession UUID when running in environments without crypto.randomUUID (older browsers).
